items.title: For an m-regular coherent sheaf the multiplication map from the m-th twist and linear forms onto the (m+1)-st twist is surjective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves surjectivity of the multiplication map H^0(F(m)) tensor H^0(O(1)) -> H^0(F(m+1)) for an m-regular coherent sheaf on projective n-space. The proof first reduces to an infinite base field: base changing the linear map along a faithfully flat extension of fields preserves it, so the statement may be checked after enlarging k (proof lines 6701-6707). It then inducts on n: the case n = 0 is trivial, and for n > 0 it applies the induction-step sequence tensored by O(m+1), takes a section t of the (m+1)-st twist, uses the induction hypothesis to lift its restriction to the hyperplane, and uses the vanishing H^1(F(m-1)) = 0 supplied by m-regularity together with the long exact sequence to lift t itself (proof lines 6710-6739). H2: the field reduction and the two-stage lifting through the exact sequence are the substance.
